Til. 3</ls>; <ls>Me. 19</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 14</ls>. .²2 A precious stone, jewel. <ls>Y. 3. 36</ls>. ‘उपलः प्रस्तरे मणौ’ इति विश्वः. .²3 Sand (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²4 A cloud. .²5 A ball thrown from some artifice (as gun); कपाटयन्त्रदुर्धर्षा बभूवुः सहुडोपलाः <ls>Mb. 3. 284. 4</ls>. .{@-ला@} .²1 Refined sugar, (उपलासिता Sugar-candy). .²2 The upper and smaller millstone which rests on the Dṛṣad.
